cluster_reason: StrBuilder, StrTokenizer and StrMatcher form a tightly coupled utility cluster: StrBuilder and StrTokenizer call into StrMatcher and each other frequently (mutual internal_deps). They likely share package-private interactions and represent string manipulation internals distinct from formatting utilities. Moving them together preserves their internal visibility and reduces the size of the god package while keeping a cohesive unit that can be encapsulated in a dedicated subpackage.

blocks.goal: Move the cohesive StrBuilder/StrTokenizer/StrMatcher cluster to a dedicated subpackage to reduce the God Component size.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage org.apache.commons.lang3.text.internal to host string-processing internals.
Move StrBuilder to the internal subpackage to colocate it with its tokenizer and matcher collaborators.
Move StrTokenizer alongside StrBuilder and StrMatcher to preserve package-private interactions.
Move StrMatcher with its main consumers to the internal subpackage to minimize visibility changes between them.

After moving the whole cluster to the destination package, update only the minimum required visibility in moved classes and related remaining classes so the project can compile. Do not change behavior. Do not move additional classes.
